title: SDD orchestrator driven by the tier router
planning_assumption: Plan to v1.0.0 (Codex only) approved in chat on 2026-10-14 with full access. Tasks run outside the coordinator per AGENTS.md (decision D6). Tasks declare tier instead of profile/model/effort (decision D1), so the validator's routed-field warnings are expected.

milestones.title: Orquestador en la app
exit_criteria: Every task completed with verify evidence.
Every scenario has evidence in acceptance-evidence.md, including an end-to-end run in the real app against Codex.
Manifests at 0.8.0, CI green on main, signed tag and release.

acceptance_scenarios.precondition: A project with specs/<slug>/tasks.json whose tasks declare tier and milestone.
acceptance_scenarios.action: List the project's specs and load one.
acceptance_scenarios.observable_result: Tasks, milestones, dependencies, acceptance and verify command are imported and listed; reloading keeps lifecycle state.
acceptance_scenarios.verification: cargo test -p router-core task_manifest; Tasks screen in the fixture

acceptance_scenarios.precondition: A manifest whose tasks use profile/model/effort (for example specs/003-desktop-hook/tasks.json).
acceptance_scenarios.observable_result: Each profile maps to a tier (micro/routine -> economico, standard -> estandar, deep/frontier -> fuerte); declared model/effort are ignored and reported as a warning.

acceptance_scenarios.precondition: Manifests with a cycle, a missing dependency, an unknown tier or a danger-full-access sandbox.
acceptance_scenarios.observable_result: Rejected with a specific error; nothing is imported.

acceptance_scenarios.precondition: A task with tier estandar and a router.toml.
acceptance_scenarios.action: Dispatch it, change router.toml, dispatch another estandar task.
acceptance_scenarios.observable_result: Each run records the model and effort router.toml had at dispatch time.

acceptance_scenarios.precondition: A task whose prompt matches a risk rule, declared economico.
acceptance_scenarios.action: Load it, then lower it manually and dispatch.
acceptance_scenarios.observable_result: It resolves to fuerte with the rule as reason; the manual change is stored and the run records it as manual.

acceptance_scenarios.precondition: Tasks with incomplete dependencies or approval manual.
acceptance_scenarios.action: Dispatch them; approve one; deny another.
acceptance_scenarios.observable_result: No turn starts until dependencies are completed and approval is granted; a denied task stays blocked.

acceptance_scenarios.precondition: A ready task dispatched from the app.
acceptance_scenarios.action: Watch the run; answer a command approval; stop another run.
acceptance_scenarios.observable_result: Text streams into the Tasks screen, the approval appears inline and its answer reaches Codex; stopping ends the turn as interrupted.
acceptance_scenarios.verification: cargo test -p router-core --test task_coordinator; fixture and real app

acceptance_scenarios.observable_result: Exit 0 completes the task with the command output as evidence; any other exit fails it with the output.

acceptance_scenarios.precondition: A spec with independent and dependent ready tasks.
acceptance_scenarios.observable_result: Tasks run one at a time in dependency order; a failure does not run its dependents.

acceptance_scenarios.precondition: An interrupted run, and a task blocked by thread.resume.failed.
acceptance_scenarios.action: Resume the first; retry the second.
acceptance_scenarios.observable_result: Resume continues the same thread without repeating a completed turn; the blocked task can be retried with a new run.

acceptance_scenarios.action: spec-load, task-approve, task-run and task-dispatch on a tier manifest.
acceptance_scenarios.observable_result: The CLI follows the same tiers and gates; approval requests from Codex are declined there.

acceptance_scenarios.action: Codex starts the turn and the verify command.
acceptance_scenarios.observable_result: Both carry ROUDEX_ROUTER_INTERNAL and ROUDEX_ACTIVE_TASK_ID: the Desktop hook skips them and coordinator commands refuse to run inside them.
acceptance_scenarios.verification: cargo test -p router-core --test task_coordinator; cargo test -p router-cli --test task_cli

acceptance_scenarios.precondition: The example spec in the repository and the real Codex runtime.
acceptance_scenarios.action: Load and run it from the app.
acceptance_scenarios.observable_result: Every task completes with verification evidence, visible in the Tasks screen.
